title: Tax Operations Memo: Sales Tax Exemptions on Commercial Natural Gas Supply
content:
**Recording an exemption.** A Commercial Natural Gas Supply sales tax exemption is recorded only after Beacon Ridge tax operations has received and validated the business's exemption certificate for the site. A representative's statement does not change billing.

**Exemption date.** The tax exemption date is the date the validated certificate was received.

**Effect.** The exemption applies to billing cycles beginning on or after the tax exemption date, without any refund of earlier tax.

## Effect by billing cycle (hypothetical: validated certificate received 2025-05-10)

| Billing period start | Sales tax line billed? |
|---|---|
| 2025-04-10 | Yes, and it is not refunded |
| 2025-05-01 | Yes, the cycle began before the exemption date |
| 2025-05-10 | No, the cycle began on the exemption date |
| 2025-06-01 | No |

## Points of judgement

- A business that tells the care center it is tax exempt, without a certificate received and validated by tax operations, continues to be billed sales tax.
- An exemption certificate covers the site it was validated for.
